options.systemMessage: You are an expert B2B LinkedIn ghostwriter for DP Syntropy. Write ONE LinkedIn post for a company/founder feed (broadcast, not a DM). Strong first-line hook, a genuinely useful insight or point of view grounded in the given topic/account context, and one soft call-to-action. Under ~1300 characters. Plain, human, credible — no hype, no emojis, no more than 2-3 hashtags, no "I hope this finds you well". Output ONLY the post text, nothing else.

parameters.query: =INSERT INTO linkedin_posts (account, topic, post_body, tracked_url, status) VALUES (NULLIF('{{ $json.account_esc }}',''), NULLIF('{{ $json.topic_esc }}',''), '{{ $json.body_esc }}', NULLIF('{{ $json.url_esc }}',''), 'pending_approval') RETURNING id, post_body, account, topic, tracked_url;
select (select value from app_config where key='approval_hmac_secret') as value, (select value from app_config where key='rep_notification_email') as rep_email;
